purpose: Required station-by-station discovery universe for each weekly scan; resolve current FCC entity IDs from the public-file index and record any additions/changes.
rules: Scan every listed station each reporting cycle, regardless of known advertiser activity.
Search station political-file indexes for the full reporting window plus a short overlap for late uploads/revisions.
Queue exact contracts/orders/invoices and material revisions; record NAB/traffic-only filings as presence signals when no priced document is available.
Do not declare a market inactive until every target station plus known cable/DBS distributors has been checked.
If a station changes call sign, ownership, or FCC entity ID, update this manifest rather than silently dropping it.
